data.name: As We Planned
data.detailed_description:
PVE Stealth Extraction

Drop into the location, rob the villain, and carry home as much of his loot as possible. Stay cautious — if all of you get caught, you'll lose everything you brought with you.

Stay in the Shadows

For a perfect run, you must remain undetected and leave no traces behind. Going in loud is an option, but it comes with consequences.

Tools for the Perfect Heist

Bring specialized tools that will help you rob villains more efficiently or reach hard-to-access spots — where, as a rule, even more valuable loot awaits.

Bring Your Friends

Gameplay for up to 4 players. Work together for greater efficiency. Boost each other up to reach higher places. Help your teammates break free from captivity. Revive fallen comrades. The more friends you have, the more loot you can carry home.

Solve Puzzles

Each run on the location generates new obstacles — overcome them to earn greater rewards.

Upgrade Your Base

Use your hard-earned spoils to improve your base, unlocking access to more advanced tools and visually transforming your hideout.

Complete Quests and Level Up Your Reputation

Take on jobs for characters in the game world to earn rewards and uncover their stories.

Collect 'Em All

Unlock new outfits for your characters and valuable trophies to display proudly at your base for all to see.
